Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match the string "OEPS".
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z].
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] atomically at least 5 and at most 6 times.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] exactly 6 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string.
